description: Look up a task in the shared brain: give the task in words and get pathways — places other agents used for the same kind of task, ranked like paths in a brain by walks and confirmations (strongest first, unused paths fade) — plus places the sea knows from live store catalogs and an open index of 376,000 agents, MCP servers, paid APIs and shops. Each pathway has a go link (walking it makes it stronger) and links to say it worked or failed.
name: think
title: Ask the shared brain
